title: I was charged twice for the same recharge — how do I get a refund?
content:
Question: I was charged twice for the same recharge — how do I get a refund?

Answer: ### Short Answer

Duplicate-charge refunds are usually auto-detected and reversed within 3-5 working days. If not, raise a ticket under Billing > Report Issue with both transaction references; approved refunds are credited to the original payment method or as account balance.

### Detailed Explanation

Auto-detection is the default path (3-5 working days), and the manual ticket route exists specifically as the fallback for when auto-detection doesn't catch it — the two transaction references are needed precisely because it's a duplicate-charge case, so the system needs to see both transactions to link them.

### Key Details

| Detail | Value |
|---|---|
| Default handling | Auto-detected and reversed within 3-5 working days |
| If not auto-resolved | Raise a ticket under Billing > Report Issue with both transaction references |
| Where refund lands | Original payment method, or as account balance |

### Troubleshooting

| Symptom | Possible Cause | Diagnostic Check | Recommended Action |
|---|---|---|---|
| Duplicate charge, <5 working days since it occurred | Still within the auto-detection and reversal window | Whether the duplicate has been auto-reversed yet | Wait out the standard 3-5 working day window first |
| Duplicate charge, 5+ working days, not reversed | Auto-detection did not catch this instance | Both transaction references for the duplicate charges | Raise a ticket under Billing > Report Issue with both references |

### Escalation

Raising a ticket under Billing > Report Issue is the documented step once the 3-5 working day auto-detection window has passed without a reversal.

### Example Scenario

**Customer situation:** A customer notices two identical recharge charges on the same day and it's been a week with no refund.

**What happens:** Since this is beyond the standard 3-5 working day auto-detection window, raising a ticket under Billing > Report Issue with both transaction references is the next step.
